headline: Bitcoin slides below $84k amid liquidity hunt, eyeing key support
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC broke the 84,000‑84,500 resistance zone and is now testing the 81,800–82,200 support cluster; the 4H shows a descending channel with higher lows holding, suggesting a short‑term pull‑back before a potential retest of the 80,500 floor.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑momentum altcoins, with MET (+36.8%), GTC (+33.5%), SAND (+17.4%) and W (+14.7%) leading the rally as risk appetite shifts from Bitcoin.
strategy_outlook: Spot traders may add positions on dips near $81,800 with stops below $81,200, while futures players should keep net short or hedge with tight stops above $84,500.
